name: IMBdx
summary: IMBdx, Inc. specializes in developing advanced liquid biopsy technologies for cancer detection and management. The company's core mission revolves around three key areas: facilitating the diagnosis and treatment strategies for advanced-stage cancers, enabling the early identification of cancer recurrence after surgical interventions, and providing solutions for the early diagnosis of cancer. Its notable product offerings include AlphaLiquid, CancerDetect, and CancerFind. The firm was established by Tae-Yu Kim, Sung-Tae Moon, and Doo-Hee Bang on July 5, 2018, and maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
